library.title: Library
library.noFavoritesText: Click ★ on a game to add it to favorites.

gameCard.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall {{name}}? Its uninstaller will open: it asks the final question and removes the files. Cassini deletes nothing itself.
gameCard.uninstallConfirmSteam: Uninstall {{name}}? Steam will open its uninstall window.
gameCard.uninstallStarted: Uninstall started by {{name}}. Refresh the library once it finishes.
gameCard.uninstallNone: Cassini can’t uninstall {{name}}: Windows doesn’t know it under that name. Use Windows’ installed apps instead.
gameCard.uninstallFailed: The uninstall could not be started: {{error}}

emptyState.title: Your library is empty
emptyState.subtitle: Add your first games to start tracking your collection.

launchers.title: Launchers
launchers.desktopOnly: Desktop only: launcher detection works in the Tauri app (not in the web preview).

music.chooseFirst: Choose a folder to get started.
music.deleteFolderWithTracks_one: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and the track it contains?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, library and app behaviour.
settings.bgErrorType: Unsupported file: an image is required.
settings.overlayHint: Darkening applied to the background image.
settings.accentHint: Colour of buttons and active navigation.
settings.sgdbHint: Covers for Epic, Battle.net and other games. Optional; without a key, the game’s initials are shown.
settings.updateHint: Looks for a new version of Cassini.
settings.clearAllHint: Deletes the library, settings and cache, then restarts the app.
settings.clearWebviewCacheHint: Images and resources cached by the app. Does not affect the web browser.
settings.musicParticlesHint: Animated snow particles on the Music page.
settings.showLibraryHint: Library button in the launcher bar.
settings.showLaunchersHint: Launchers button in the launcher bar.
settings.runInBgHint: Closing the window minimises Cassini to the notification area.
settings.patchNotesHint: New features and fixes in the latest version.
settings.planetPlaytimeHint: Steam playtime instead of disk space. Other launchers use disk space.
settings.startSystemHint: System shown at launch. If it no longer exists: automatic.

solar.resizeHint: {{label}} — drag, or use the left and right arrow keys. Double-click: default width.

systems.name: Name
systems.deleteConfirm: Delete the “{{name}}” system? Its games stay in the library and in their launcher.

editor.appliesOnSave: The name, icon and color apply when you save.
editor.editingNote: While editing, planets stay where you put them.
editor.sortNote: Only changes orbit order. A planet you placed stays where you put it.
editor.launcherNote: A launcher’s system: its games come from the library. Its sun, orbits and planets can be adjusted here.
editor.dragNote: Drag a planet in the scene to place it: it follows its orbit, and its distance to the sun follows the mouse.

image.use: Use this image as the icon
image.drop: Choose an image, or drop one here
image.rules: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG · 8 MB max · 16 px min. Square works best: a large image is cropped automatically.

errors.type: This format isn’t supported: choose a PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF or SVG.
errors.petite: Image too small: it needs at least 16 px per side.

flyKeys.title: Movement
flyKeys.note: Keys are matched by their position on the keyboard, whatever its layout: WASD on QWERTY, ZQSD on AZERTY.

errors.noLaunchTarget: No launch target is set for this game.
errors.desktopOnlyLaunch: Launching a local program only works in the desktop app.
errors.dialogUnavailable: The file picker is not available.

v4_0_0.new_0: [Interface] New spaceship-cockpit interface: frames, telemetry and instrument fonts
v4_0_0.new_1: [Settings] Settings open as a panel over the solar system, without leaving the view
v4_0_0.new_2: [Music] Compact player over the solar system, and a “now playing” strip at the bottom left
v4_0_0.new_3: [Languages] The whole app in French and English
v4_0_0.new_4: [Library] Uninstall a game from its card, through its own uninstaller
v4_0_0.new_5: [Library] Refresh button, and automatic update when you come back to the app
v4_0_0.new_6: [Systems] Custom systems: name, icon, colour and hand-picked games
v4_0_0.new_7: [Systems] Your own image as a system icon, cropped automatically
v4_0_0.new_8: [Systems] Custom star colour, and automatic planet sorting
v4_0_0.new_9: [Solar system] Adjustable width for the game list and launcher bar
v4_0_0.new_10: [Shortcuts] Keyboard shortcuts, listed with the “?” key
v4_0_0.fix_0: [Solar system] Arc rings read as rings again, without flickering
v4_0_0.fix_1: [Library] Hytale no longer stays “installed” after its launcher is uninstalled
v4_0_0.fix_2: [Music] Player progress and volume adjustable with the keyboard
v4_0_0.fix_3: [Languages] The chosen language is remembered between sessions
v4_0_0.perf_0: [Solar system] The scene pauses when a panel covers it: no more slowdown when opening settings
v4_0_0.perf_1: [Solar system] Less graphics memory used on every frame
v4_0_0.change_0: [Navigation] The sidebar is gone: library and launchers can be re-enabled from settings
v4_0_0.change_1: [Security] Dependencies updated, and uninstalling guarded against system programs

v3_0_0.new_0: [Cassini] ArcHive is now called Cassini, after the man who found the division in Saturn’s rings
v3_0_0.new_1: [Solar system] Every launcher in a single galaxy: the camera glides from one system to the next
v3_0_0.new_2: [Solar system] Launcher rail beside the list, which flies the camera to the chosen system
v3_0_0.new_3: [Solar system] Haze as systems come into range, and suns that shine from afar
v3_0_0.new_4: [Solar system] Four families of planetary rings, modelled on the solar system
v3_0_0.new_5: [Library] Search covers the whole library, across every launcher
v3_0_0.new_6: [Library] Installed and uninstalled games separated in the list
v3_0_0.new_7: [Library] Disk space used and free shown above the search box
v3_0_0.new_8: [Library] All seven launchers are scanned on every launch
v3_0_0.new_9: [Navigation] Collapsible side panel, remembered between sessions
v3_0_0.new_10: [Global] One instance at a time: launching again brings back the existing window
v3_0_0.new_11: [Launchers] Launchers absent from the PC are reported as not found
v3_0_0.fix_0: [Solar system] Clicking a game sent the camera into the void at the centre of the galaxy
v3_0_0.fix_1: [Solar system] The game card no longer sits on top of the planet it describes
v3_0_0.fix_2: [Solar system] The galaxy no longer rearranges itself on every library scan
v3_0_0.fix_3: [Solar system] Distant planets no longer flicker before vanishing
v3_0_0.fix_4: [Ambiance] Ambient music no longer restarts on top of a playing track
v3_0_0.fix_5: [Navigation] A collapsed panel no longer leaves empty space behind it
v3_0_0.perf_0: [Solar system] Systems built on approach and released on departure: one to three seconds of freeze gone
v3_0_0.perf_1: [Solar system] Collapsing a panel no longer resizes the canvas on every frame
v3_0_0.perf_2: [Startup] Storage is only rewritten when the library has actually changed
v3_0_0.change_0: [Solar system] The launcher dropdown is replaced by the icon rail
v3_0_0.change_1: [Ambiance] Music stops when the window leaves the screen

v2_1_0.new_0: [Solar system] Phase portals to jump between launchers without leaving the view
v2_1_0.new_1: [Solar system] Keyboard movement (WASD / ZQSD), remappable keys and adjustable sensitivity
v2_1_0.new_2: [Solar system] Game card next to its planet, collapsible game list, frame counter
v2_1_0.new_3: [Ambiance] Three tracks chained with a crossfade, one picked at random on startup
v2_1_0.fix_0: [Solar system] Rings are no longer reserved for the largest planets
v2_1_0.fix_1: [Solar system] Guaranteed wide gap between the sun and the innermost orbit
v2_1_0.fix_2: [Library] Game count displayed three times over
v2_1_0.fix_3: [Library] Launchers absent from the PC are no longer offered in the filter
v2_1_0.fix_4: [Library] Game folder access restored for Steam games
v2_1_0.perf_0: [Startup] Opens straight onto the solar system, intro animation removed
v2_1_0.perf_1: [Startup] Settings loaded in a single call instead of a couple of dozen

v1_2_0.new_0: [Music] Metadata saved directly into audio files, no more network search on startup
v1_2_0.new_1: [Music] Change artwork via right-click, image embedded directly into the audio file
v1_2_0.new_2: [Music] MusicBrainz added as a 3rd artwork source, no API key required
v1_2_0.new_3: [Music] Animated snow particles in the background of the music page
v1_2_0.new_4: [Settings] Option to disable animated particles in the Ambiance section
v1_2_0.fix_0: [Music] Raised match threshold for fewer incorrect covers

v1_1_3.new_0: [Music] Last 10 played tracks section, persisted across sessions
v1_1_3.new_2: [Mini-player] Animated appearance and disappearance of the persistent bar
v1_1_3.new_3: [Music] Move a track to another folder via right-click
v1_1_3.fix_0: [Mini-player] Play/pause/prev/next buttons no longer shift based on track title length
v1_1_3.fix_1: [Settings] App now correctly stays in background when closing the window
v1_1_3.fix_2: [Mini-player] Clicking the track title now navigates to the correct folder
v1_1_3.change_0: [Global] Visual redesign of sidebar, typography, scrollbars and hover animations

v1_1_2.new_0: [Music] Automatic artwork search via iTunes for all tracks
v1_1_2.new_1: [Mini-player] Online artwork now displayed in the bottom bar
v1_1_2.new_3: [Music] Shuffle and repeat modes for track playback
v1_1_2.new_4: [Mini-player] Shuffle and repeat buttons, state saved between sessions
v1_1_2.new_5: [Mini-player] Draggable thumb on progress and volume bars
v1_1_2.new_6: [Music] Refresh button to rescan the folder without reselecting it
v1_1_2.fix_0: [Library] Steam game images stay visible even after uninstalling
v1_1_2.fix_1: [Music] Enrichment now processes all tracks from app startup
v1_1_2.fix_2: [Mini-player] No more audio glitch when dragging the progress bar
v1_1_2.fix_3: [Mini-player] Reliable play and pause after scrubbing the track
v1_1_2.perf_0: [Music] Stricter artwork matching to avoid incorrect results

v1_1_1.new_0: [Settings] Release notes displayed on every new version
v1_1_1.perf_0: [Music] Large music libraries load much faster
v1_1_1.perf_1: [Music] Album artwork loads progressively as you scroll
v1_1_1.perf_2: [Music] Progress bar while track metadata is loading

v1_1_0.new_0: [Music] Track title, artist, album and duration displayed automatically
v1_1_0.new_1: [Music] Full album artwork on track cards with duration overlay
v1_1_0.new_2: [Music] Text stays readable on light-coloured artwork

v1_0_51.new_0: [Global] Built-in dialogs, no more browser popups
v1_0_51.new_1: [Global] Visual notifications for confirmations and action feedback
v1_0_51.new_2: [Settings] Update available notification with download progress
v1_0_51.new_3: [Mini-player] Artwork, artist name and volume control in the persistent bar
v1_0_51.new_4: [Music] Customisable colour per folder via right-click
v1_0_51.new_5: [Music] Drag and drop tracks between folders
v1_0_51.change_0: [Music] Track durations stay visible when navigating between pages
v1_0_51.change_1: [Music] Sort tracks by name, duration or file type

v1_0_0.new_0: [Library] Game library with automatic detection of Steam, Epic Games and Battle.net
v1_0_0.new_1: [Music] Built-in music player with folder management
v1_0_0.new_3: [Settings] Customisable background image and accent colour
v1_0_0.new_4: [Settings] Automatic launch of ArcHive on Windows startup
v1_0_0.new_5: [Settings] Minimise to system tray when closing the window
